text:
Type: large natural fiber flatwoven rug
Use: anchoring a large seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: rustic, contemporary, Japandi
Materials: tightly woven sisal-look plant fiber, dark bound fabric edge
Colors: dark chocolate brown, copper flecks, dark brown border
Shape: large rectangle with fine tight weave, narrow bound border, thin and firm, grounding visual weight
Feel: warm, earthy, grounded, rich
Goes with: dark or warm wood, leather, cream walls, brass accents; rustic, Japandi or classic living and dining rooms

product.name: OSTED
product.description: The rug is hard-wearing and durable because its made of sisal, a natural fibre taken from the agave plant.
